headline: Yield intelligence moves to protocol-native adapters as sixteen stablecoin additions take tracking to 185.
fieldNotes: Yield was the week's main build: more than ten protocol-native adapters joined the pipeline, and benchmarks now follow each peg's own risk-free rate, including EUR and CHF. The catalog grew in the same stretch, with Liquity v2 forks, non-USD fiat coins, and a MiCA-regulated CHF stablecoin. Every AI editorial summary was rewritten, and the week closed with an audit remediation pass covering validation, SQL safety, and cron observability.

summary.label: Yield intelligence overhaul
summary.description: 10+ protocol-native adapters (Aave V3, Compound V3, Morpho, Pendle, Beefy, Yearn Kong), benchmark-aware scoring, coverage audits, and 365-day backfill charts

summary.label: Broader stablecoin coverage
summary.description: ftUSD, CHFAU, USDKG, USDh, ctUSD, trUSD, Liquity v2 forks USDQ and USDK, and non-USD coins including BRLA, IDRX, MXNB, and CJPY added; five dead coins moved to the cemetery

summary.label: Detail page depth
summary.description: All 174 AI editorial summaries rewritten, a new Used as Collateral section, chain and DEX distribution donuts, and Liquity fork lineage badges

summary.label: Design polish
summary.description: RegimeBar PSI indicator, confidence typography, chart tooltip standardization, an interactive Safety Score calculator, and the stablecoin table promoted to the homepage hero

summary.label: Blacklist coverage
summary.description: PayPal USD and USD1 freeze tracking (methodology v3.3), blacklistability in the hero and homepage table, gold-peg freeze chart support, and a quarterly freeze ledger

summary.label: Reserve and backstop depth
summary.description: Redemption backstop confidence upgraded across lower-cap and medium-confidence tranches; live reserves added for reUSD and USDD, reaching 119 live-enabled coins

summary.label: Status page upgrades
summary.description: Telegram delivery summary, degraded-first cache freshness tables, tripped-first circuit breaker tables, and aligned admin and public health semantics

summary.label: Codebase hardening
summary.description: Audit remediation passes add Zod validation at boundaries, SQL interpolation and stablecoin-data CI checks, error boundaries on eight pages, and remove the webhook secret query fallback
